--metrics_exporter none \

--traces_exporter console \
--metrics_exporter none \
--service_name hello-otel \

-e OTEL_SERVICE_NAME=java-demo \

$ podman run --rm --name mounted-agent -p 9999:9999 \
-v ./opentelemetry-javaagent-2.30.0.jar:/otel/agent.jar:ro \
-e JAVA_TOOL_OPTIONS="-javaagent:/otel/agent.jar" \
-e OTEL_SERVICE_NAME=java-demo \
-e OTEL_TRACES_EXPORTER=logging \
-e OTEL_METRICS_EXPORTER=none \
-e OTEL_LOGS_EXPORTER=none \
java-demo
